Pi.bar_b_note: A naturalistic, well-furred coyote that matches the owner style bar carries it; the flat grey stage has no Valheim-class light, but the model finish holds up.

Gq.bar_b_note: A's dark wolf with blue veins is on-board but low contrast with no rim light; B's crude gold leg bands and flare blur the creature's identity.

As.bar_b_note: Gold frills and the leopard-spotted hide read well in A, but B's faint frames lose the material and turn to a pale untextured body, and the creature barely matches the trainer's height.

Zk.bar_b_note: A solid naturalistic boar, but it is plain brown with none of the board's moss accents, stands about trainer height, and is lit flat.

Jz.bar_b_note: B's gold-frilled, spotted hide and its swimming frame carry it, but A's red-pink frills on a washed-out grey-pink body sink that side.

Xd.bar_b_note: The teal newt with its cream crest matches the board's water palette, but it sits low next to the trainer and the stage gives it no rim or atmosphere.

Ph.bar_b_note: An appealing grandfather villager with expressive eyes and a natural olive and cream palette that fits the cozy Meadows; his face is more cartoon than the naturalistic creatures.

Ox.bar_b_note: A's dark scales with gold veins are close to the Fulgocobra board, but B's faint frames float the snake upright in mid-air above a detached shadow, in a saturated wasp-yellow off the board.

Wr.bar_b_note: Murky brown frames with no purple storm sky or white-violet lightning, flat magenta telegraph rings, a heavy HUD and a near-invisible player creature sink it.

Pw.bar_b_note: Blurry low-res terrain and wall textures, sparse even vegetation and flat skies sink it; A's smoke columns and removed banners give some site-specific aftermath.

top_changes.change: Stormwood fight readability: replace the flat magenta rings and triangles with real ground-crack and white-violet lightning tells and impacts, keep the camera out of trunks and canopy (A i11/i13/i15), add the purple storm sky and rim light on both fighters, and slim the HUD side panels so the player's creature reads.

Meadows aftermath sites: swap the blurry terrain and wall materials for sharper ones, group grass and trees into groves and edges, add a warm Valheim-style sky and fog grade, and make each after frame clearly site-specific (remove the red enemy banners, add smoke, freed creatures and toppled props).

Creature stage pass: keep faint poses grounded (Ox B floats), stop the material loss in faint frames (As B turns white), keep frills gold rather than red (Jz A), drop Gq B's crude gold leg bands, and add a rim light so dark creatures separate from the backdrop.
